native_export_evidence.scope: Actual fixed-verifier output for all 219 theorem constants owned by the nine compiled physical source modules: displayed types, stored universe parameters, all direct proof constants, direct theorem constants, ownership and transitive axiom closure. The 102 public source candidates additionally carry registered direct proof edges.

native_execution.source_binding: The actual successful build receipt binds the ten-file source manifest. Source bytes and real logs were checked again after native execution and at finalization; both Lean-exported complete JSON objects match exactly.
